indicators.label: Religious affiliation (%)
indicators.description: Share of the resident population in the four affiliation categories (Musulmane, Chrétienne, Animiste, Autre religion).
indicators.method: Sum of the four published affiliation-category one-decimal shares from Table 5.10, rounded to one decimal. No count is derived from any percentage.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Eight ADM1 regions on the geoBoundaries 2017 boundary; the census region frame is stable across the 1983/1996/2014 vintages, so the region layer needs no concordance.
indicators.quality_notes: One-decimal published shares. The Faranah row's five categories sum to 99.9 by the source's rounding, so its affiliation (99.1) plus no-religion (0.8) sum to 99.9, within the 0.25 pp derived bound.

indicators.label: No religion (%)
indicators.description: Sans religion as a share of the resident population.
indicators.method: The published Sans religion one-decimal share from Table 5.10, carried unchanged.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Eight ADM1 regions on the geoBoundaries 2017 boundary; the census region frame is stable across the 1983/1996/2014 vintages, so the region layer needs no concordance.
indicators.quality_notes: Sans religion is a real non-affiliation category inside the denominator and outside the affiliation numerator.

visual_layers.label: Religious affiliation share
visual_layers.description: Census religious affiliation share by region, 2014.
visual_layers.aggregation_rule: published regional value on the 2017 boundary
visual_layers.notes: N'Zérékoré (46.7% Muslim, 28.1% Christian, 10.4% Animist, 14.2% no religion) is the map-worthy contrast against the near-uniform 89-99% Muslim north.

visual_layers.label: No religion share
visual_layers.aggregation_rule: published regional value on the 2017 boundary
visual_layers.notes: Single wave; no cross-wave change layer (subnational religion is published for 2014 only).

Region resident totals exist in Table 2.09 but are not multiplied into the shares (no derived-count layer).
